notes: Intel Tiber dev-cloud Panther Lake box: Core Ultra X7 358H, Arc B390 iGPU, 64 GB (63.4 GB usable), Windows 11. OpenVINO INT4 export of Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (18 GB) whole on the iGPU. decodeTps is the medium prompt (975 tokens after the chat template, 256 generated, temperature 0, thinking off) averaged over 3 timed repeats after 1 warm-up: (completion tokens - 1) / (request wall time - time to first token), where TTFT is a separate max_tokens=1 request; ttftMs is the same medium prompt's median. Decode drew 34.2 W package power (1.23 tok/J), 79.5 GB/s DDR bandwidth. A signed-INT4 GPTQ export of the same model reached 53.4 tok/s on this box.
